reason: Early November is nothing for me, Ramadan and Eid are months away and I don't have a wedding on the calendar, so I'm not buying a thobe just because a store opened. I'd probably sign up for the Ramadan early-access list and walk in to look later.
objection: From the list it sounds like standard embroidered thobes and plain abayas, the same stuff I already see on Hillcroft. I want something that feels new and a bit fashion-forward each season, not either very traditional Gulf style or basic.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the actual pieces, if there is something genuinely different and modern for a wedding or henna night that I can't find at the Hillcroft shops, and an invitation coming up that I need it for.
